themes.label: North-South digital divide including AI access
themes.definition: Unequal access to the internet and AI between rich and developing (especially African) countries, with calls to bridge the digital divide.
themes.inclusion: Include passages demanding universal, affordable access to internet/AI or describing a widening North-South gap.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages about AI governance or risks without access content.
themes.boundary_cases: If AI is mentioned only as part of internet access, still code here when the argument concerns the divide.

examples.quote: it is becoming imperative for all countries to have access to the Internet, including artificial intelligence, which is revolutionizing the world as we speak
the so-called spider web favours rich countries while developing countries are still poorly connected, particularly in Africa

value.rationale: Single Burundi passage about the digital divide; AI is folded into internet access as something developing countries must also access, with no separate governance or risk discussion.
